svg.title: Where each extension lives
svg.desc: Three columns. Inside the model's context window, built-in tools, the system prompt, CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, skill names, deferred MCP tool or server names and subagent types are in every request, while a skill's full instructions, a loaded MCP tool definition, files read and tool results are added when used. Hooks, skill scripts, subagents' work and MCP server code run outside the context, and only their output enters it.
